title: Getting Ready for the Talent Show
passage:
Next Friday, Chen Wei's class will have a talent show. He and his best friend Lisa are planning to sing a song together on stage. Every afternoon after school, they rehearse in the music room.

"I'm so nervous," Chen Wei said while tuning his guitar. "What if I forget the words?"

"Don't worry," Lisa said with a smile. "If you practice every day, you will remember everything by Friday. You always work hard, so I'm sure we'll do great."

They usually rehearse for an hour, but yesterday they were too tired to finish the whole song. "Let's take a short break," Lisa suggested. "We can try again in ten minutes."

After the break, they practiced the song again. This time, Chen Wei sang confidently enough to make Lisa smile. "See? If you stay calm, you will sound wonderful," she said.

On the day of the show, the auditorium was full of students and teachers. Backstage, Chen Wei's hands were shaking, but Lisa held his hand. "If we make a mistake, we will just keep smiling," she whispered. "The audience won't even notice."

When their names were called, they walked onto the stage. The bright lights were almost too strong to see the crowd, but they heard the loud applause. They took a deep breath and began to sing. Their voices blended perfectly, and everyone clapped along.

After the performance, their teacher praised them. "You two rarely make mistakes, and today you were amazing!" Chen Wei grinned. "If we keep practicing like this, we will join the city competition next year," he said happily.

grammar: 第一條件句 (First Conditional)：「If + 現在簡單式, ... will + 原形動詞」用來表達「有可能發生」的未來條件與結果。例如：If you practice every day, you will remember everything.（if 子句用現在式，主要子句用 will + 原形動詞，不可用 will 兩次）。
too + 形容詞 + to V / 形容詞 + enough to V：「too...to」表示「太…以致於不能…」，帶有負面結果（they were too tired to finish）；「...enough to」表示「足夠…以至於能…」，帶有正面結果（confidently enough to make Lisa smile）。
頻率副詞 (always/usually/often/rarely/never) 的位置：放在一般動詞之前、be 動詞之後。例如：You always work hard.（work 是一般動詞，always 放其前）；You two rarely make mistakes.（rarely 放在一般動詞 make 之前）。

reading.q: What event will Chen Wei's class have next Friday?

reading.q: What are Chen Wei and Lisa planning to do on stage?
reading.ex: 文中提到他們「are planning to sing a song together on stage」。

reading.q: Why couldn't they finish rehearsing the whole song yesterday?
reading.ex: 文中提到「they were too tired to finish the whole song」。

reading.q: What did Lisa do when Chen Wei's hands were shaking backstage?
opts: She held his hand and whispered to him
reading.ex: 文中提到「Lisa held his hand」並「she whispered」安慰他。

reading.q: What did their teacher say after the performance?
opts: They rarely make mistakes and were amazing
They should join a different competition
reading.ex: 文中提到老師說「You two rarely make mistakes, and today you were amazing!」。

grammar.q: "If you practice every day, you ______ remember everything by Friday."
grammar.ex: 第一條件句：if 子句用現在式，主要子句用 will + 原形動詞，故選 will。

grammar.q: "They were ______ tired to finish the whole song."
grammar.ex: 「too + 形容詞 + to V」表示「太…以致於不能…」，故選 too。

grammar.q: "Chen Wei sang confidently ______ to make Lisa smile."
grammar.ex: 「形容詞/副詞 + enough + to V」表示「足夠…以至於能…」，enough 需放在副詞之後，故選 enough。

grammar.q: Which sentence has the correct position of the frequency adverb?
grammar.ex: 頻率副詞 always 應放在一般動詞 works 之前，故 She always works hard. 正確。

grammar.q: "If we make a mistake, we ______ just keep smiling."
grammar.ex: 第一條件句的主要子句用 will + 原形動詞，故選 will。

vocab.q: "The actors waited ______ before the play." (選出意思為「在後台」的單字)
